strings.La web funciona como propuesta profesion: The website works as a professional proposal in development. strings.Las actividades de riesgo estarán sujeta: Risk activities will be subject to regulations, permits, weather, minimum age, participant health, approved equipment, insurance, qualified professionals and safety criteria. strings.El usuario debe utilizar la web de forma: The user must use the website lawfully, respectfully and responsibly. Published information may change to improve safety, clarity, applicable regulations or project viability.

strings.Los datos enviados mediante formularios: Data sent through forms would be used to answer requests, assess group needs and prepare communications related to the project. Sensitive medical data should not be sent through general forms.
strings.La captación de fotografías, vídeo, dron: Capturing photos, video, drone, FPV or 360 content would require informed consent, respect for privacy and absolute priority of safety over the shot.
strings.En una versión operativa, el usuario pod: In an operational version, the user could request access, correction, deletion, limitation or objection regarding their data according to applicable regulations.
strings.Para consultas sobre privacidad, condici: For privacy, terms or project status questions you can write to nomadaextremoaguilas@gmail.com or contact Telegram: @DiegoDavidExtremo.
